recaps.headline: The Church Breaks the Record Book
recaps.dek: St. Brown Catholic Church put up **214.84** points on Bijan al-Gaib, the highest single-week score in league history. The old mark was 195.78 from 2023. Nobody in this league had ever cleared 200 before Sunday.
recaps.body:
## The headline

St. Brown Catholic Church put up **214.84** points on Bijan al-Gaib, the highest single-week score in league history. The old mark was 195.78 from 2023. Nobody in this league had ever cleared 200 before Sunday.

It was not one guy. CeeDee Lamb went for 41.3, Javonte Williams added 31.3 out of the flex, Zay Flowers chipped in 25.8 and Brock Bowers 23.6. Even the bench was loud, with Brian Robinson sitting on 25.7 points nobody needed. The Church is 4-0, leads the league in points by almost 120, and now carries a 42% title chance in the simulation.

The defending champs never had a shot. Bijan Robinson did his part with 27.7, but Ja'Marr Chase managed 5.7 and Saquon Barkley, acquired in a Week 3 trade, posted a single point in his Bijan al-Gaib debut. Final: 214.84 to 127.66.

## The rest of the slate

**Captain Jah'Merica 156.20, Drake Mungo 150.42.** The game of the week. Tetairoa McMillan had the best day of anyone in the league at 44.2, and Nico Collins added 30.8 to drag Captain Jah'Merica back to .500. Drake Mungo got 25.9 from Chuba Hubbard and 22.8 from Alvin Kamara and still lost by six, with Drake Maye's 24.16 sitting on the bench.

**Jeantrification 164.68, The Hurt Locker 135.80.** Second-highest score of the week. Puka Nacua (27.7) and Tee Higgins (26.7) did the damage, and C.J. Stroud's 23.08 in the superflex spot helped. T.J. Hockenson's 31.4 for The Hurt Locker went to waste; so did Emanuel Wilson's 26.0 on the bench.

**Unsolicited Nix pics 123.76, These Bitches Love 'Doza 78.08.** Kyren Williams went for 36.7 and the Nix pics stay perfect at 4-0. 'Doza is the league's last winless team, and the bench tells the story: Tyquan Thornton 28.1, Michael Mayer 20.2, Darius Cooper 18.3, all unused.

**Hampton Inn 132.24, Homie G Slicer's Team 118.16.** The lineup call of the week. Homie G started Kenyon Sadiq at tight end over Colston Loveland, a near coin flip by the kickoff projections (13.1 to 11.7), and Sadiq put up a zero while Loveland scored 14.7 on the bench. The margin was 14.08, so that one call decided it. Sam LaPorta's 26.4 led Hampton Inn, who pulled the upset at 38% odds.

**Big Bucky Hunter 115.52, Baby Billys Bible Bonkers 79.02.** Bucky's first win of the year, and an upset at 28% odds. Kyle Monangai carried it with 28.0. Baby Billys started two players who scored zero, Chris Bell and Greg Dulcich, and finished with the week's second-lowest total.

## Start/sit report card

- **The call that cost a game: Homie G Slicer's Team.** Kenyon Sadiq (projected 13.1) over Colston Loveland (11.7) at tight end was close enough to be a live call. Sadiq scored 0.0 and Loveland 14.7 on the bench, more than the 14.08 they lost by.
- **Left early, nobody's fault: Bijan al-Gaib.** Saquon Barkley played 7% of the snaps and Ja'Marr Chase 20%, against usual shares of 53% and 94%. That is where the 1.0 and the 5.7 came from.
- **Baby Billys Bible Bonkers:** Chris Bell (projected 6.4) over Malachi Fields (5.3) at receiver. Bell scored 0.0, Fields 13.2.
- **Best gut call: Big Bucky Hunter.** Kyle Monangai (projected 8.1) in the flex over Pat Freiermuth (9.5), and Monangai went for 28.0 to Freiermuth's 12.2, the win's biggest piece. Drake Mungo made the same-sized bet with DK Metcalf (9.6) over AJ Barner (11.0) and won it 16.5 to 2.7.
- **Bad beat: The Hurt Locker.** Braelon Allen (projected 12.7) over Emanuel Wilson (9.8) in the flex was the right start. Wilson scored 26.0 on the bench to Allen's 8.7.

## Playoff odds movers

How each team's playoff odds moved from before Week 4 kicked off to now.

| Team | Before | Now | Change |
|---|---|---|---|
| Homie G Slicer's Team | 31% | 13% | **-18** |
| Jeantrification | 80% | 91% | **+11** |
| Drake Mungo | 78% | 70% | -8 |
| Captain Jah'Merica | 51% | 58% | +7 |
| Hampton Inn | 10% | 14% | +4 |

Homie G took the biggest hit in the league, and it traces straight back to Kenyon Sadiq's zero. One tight end dud cost them close to a fifth of their playoff chances. Jeantrification nearly locked in a spot by beating a fellow bubble team, and Captain Jah'Merica's win over Drake Mungo was a two-way swing between bubble teams.

## By the numbers

- **Top starter:** Tetairoa McMillan, 44.2 (Captain Jah'Merica)
- **Biggest blowout:** St. Brown Catholic Church by 87.18
- **Closest game:** Captain Jah'Merica by 5.78
- **Upsets:** Hampton Inn (38% pregame) and Big Bucky Hunter (28%)
- **Worst bench beat:** Homie G Slicer's Team, a win left on the bench

Every loss 'Doza takes is fine, and so is every loss by three other teams. Baby Billys holds the inside track on the top spot for now, only 26 max PF clear of Bucky.

recaps.headline: Bijan al-Gaib Wins by 99 and Lands Saquon
recaps.dek: Bijan al-Gaib hung **181.82** on Big Bucky Hunter and won by 99.24, the widest margin of the season. Big Bucky Hunter's answer was to send Saquon Barkley to the same team that flattened them, taking back Brian Thomas and a 2027 2nd-round pick. Bijan al-Gaib is 3-0 with 97% playoff odds, and Big Bucky Hunter is 0-3 and down to 0%.
recaps.body:
## The headline

Bijan al-Gaib hung **181.82** on Big Bucky Hunter and won by 99.24, the widest margin of the season. Big Bucky Hunter's answer was to send Saquon Barkley to the same team that flattened them, taking back Brian Thomas and a 2027 2nd-round pick. Bijan al-Gaib is 3-0 with 97% playoff odds, and Big Bucky Hunter is 0-3 and down to 0%.

Bijan Robinson led the way with 35.3, Ja'Marr Chase added 24.8, and Christian McCaffrey (21.6) and Davante Adams (20.7) piled on. The 181.82 is the second-best score in the league this season, behind only St. Brown Catholic Church's 189.02 in Week 2, and it came with Juwan Johnson's 27.3 sitting on the bench. Bijan al-Gaib beat its own projection by 31.62 and now carries a 24% title chance, second to the Church's 43%.

Big Bucky Hunter finished with the week's lowest score at 82.58, and Harold Fannin's 27.6 was a third of it. Barkley gave them 9.0, which makes 21.0 across three weeks in Big Bucky Hunter's lineup. He now joins a Bijan al-Gaib backfield that already has Bijan Robinson and Christian McCaffrey, while Brian Thomas heads the other way.

## The rest of the slate

**Jeantrification 132.82, Drake Mungo 128.44.** The closest game of the week, and technically an upset with Jeantrification at 49% pregame. George Kittle went for 29.2 and Christian Watson 22.6, enough to cover for De'Von Achane's 1.7 on a 16.8 projection. Drake Mungo got 31.28 from Brock Purdy and 28.4 from Drake London, but Drake Maye's 2.76 in the superflex spot, with Kirk Cousins scoring 21.22 on the bench, was the game.

**St. Brown Catholic Church 147.10, Homie G Slicer's Team 133.04.** Brock Bowers posted 32.6, the best day by any starting tight end, and CeeDee Lamb added 20.2. The Church finished 18.3 under its projection and still won, which is what 3-0 teams do. Homie G Slicer's Team had the bigger tight end performance and left it on the bench: Kenyon Sadiq scored 27.0 behind Colston Loveland's 9.1 in a game decided by 14.06.

**Unsolicited Nix pics 155.34, Captain Jah'Merica 123.24.** Jahmyr Gibbs had the best line of the week at 41.4 and still lost by 32.1. Two of the three Captain Jah'Merica receivers did not show up: Tetairoa McMillan 3.7, and Khalil Shakir 1.6 on a 10.2 projection. Unsolicited Nix pics spread it around, with Garrett Wilson 26.7, Bo Nix 24.14, Derrick Henry 21.9 and Kyren Williams 21.8, and stay unbeaten at 3-0.

**Baby Billys Bible Bonkers 126.18, Hampton Inn 100.54.** The upset of the week at 20% pregame odds, and Baby Billys Bible Bonkers' first win. Tyler Shough (23.8), Trevor Lawrence (19.78) and Chris Olave (19.7) carried a lineup that beat its projection by 32.88. Hampton Inn got 22.58 from Joe Burrow and 21.0 from Kalif Raymond, but Jadarian Price (1.2) and Kenny Gainwell (3.0) gave almost nothing out of the backfield while Ollie Gordon's 14.5 sat.

**The Hurt Locker 144.50, These Bitches Love 'Doza 133.20.** These Bitches Love 'Doza came in at 4% and posted its best score of the season by a mile, 133.20 after 77.62 and 56.32. Geno Smith (26.04) and Sam Darnold (25.66) both cleared 25 at quarterback, but Jaxon Smith-Njigba's 35.36 was too much. The Hurt Locker won with Jacoby Brissett's 25.6 and Noah Fant's 21.3 on the bench, while Hunter Henry managed 2.0 on a 12.7 projection.

## Start/sit report card

- **Bad calls that got away with it:** Jeantrification started Ladd McConkey (projected 13.8) over Michael Wilson (12.3) and lost 15.3 points on the swap, 10.6 to 25.9. The Hurt Locker put Kyler Murray (17.0) in the superflex over Jacoby Brissett (15.8) and lost 15.2, 10.42 to 25.6. Both won anyway.
- **Best gut call: Bijan al-Gaib.** Davante Adams (projected 10.5) over Malik Nabers (14.5) at receiver, a 4.0-point gap, and Adams won it 20.7 to 7.6.
- **Runner-up: Baby Billys Bible Bonkers.** Chris Bell (projected 3.1) over Malachi Fields (6.6), a 3.5-point gap, paid off 10.7 to 3.9 in the upset win.
- **Bad beat, Drake Mungo:** Drake Maye (projected 17.7) over Kirk Cousins (14.4) in the superflex was the right start. Maye scored 2.76 and Cousins 21.22, an 18.46-point swing in a 4.38-point loss.
- **Bad beat, Homie G Slicer's Team:** Colston Loveland (projected 11.9) over Kenyon Sadiq (6.2) was by the book. Sadiq scored 27.0 on the bench and Loveland 9.1, and that 17.9-point gap is bigger than the 14.06 margin.

## Playoff odds movers

How each team's playoff odds moved from before Week 3 kicked off to now.

| Team | Before | Now | Change |
|---|---|---|---|
| Jeantrification | 90% | 80% | **-10** |
| Captain Jah'Merica | 44% | 51% | **+7** |
| Bijan al-Gaib | 92% | 97% | +5 |
| Hampton Inn | 14% | 10% | -4 |
| Drake Mungo | 81% | 78% | -3 |

The two biggest moves run against their own scoreboards: Jeantrification won and dropped 10, and Captain Jah'Merica lost by 32.1 and gained 7. The odds reprice the rest of the schedule every week off fresh projections, so those two moves say more about the weeks ahead than about Sunday. Bijan al-Gaib's +5 is the clean one, a 99-point win and a 3-0 start. Hampton Inn's -4 came from losing to a 20% underdog, and Drake Mungo's -3 from a 4.38-point loss.

## By the numbers

- **Top starter:** Jahmyr Gibbs, 41.4 (Captain Jah'Merica), in a loss
- **Biggest blowout:** Bijan al-Gaib by 99.24
- **Closest game:** Jeantrification by 4.38
- **Upsets:** Baby Billys Bible Bonkers (20% pregame) and Jeantrification (49%)
- **Worst bench beat:** Drake Mungo, with Kirk Cousins' 21.22 on the bench in a 4.38-point loss, one week after the same setup cost a 4.64-point loss

## Looking ahead to Week 4

recaps.headline: Hampton Inn Shows Up, the Church Shows Out
recaps.dek: St. Brown Catholic Church dropped **189.02** points on Hampton Inn, the best score of the season and just 6.76 shy of the league's all-time single-week record. Hampton Inn answered with 160.0, a number that would have beaten every other team in the league this week, and still lost by 29.02.
recaps.body:
## The headline

St. Brown Catholic Church dropped **189.02** points on Hampton Inn, the best score of the season and just 6.76 shy of the league's all-time single-week record. Hampton Inn answered with 160.0, a number that would have beaten every other team in the league this week, and still lost by 29.02.

The Church got it from everywhere. CeeDee Lamb went for 35.3 and Amon-Ra St. Brown, the man on the letterhead, added 35.2. Jared Goff threw in 27.78, Jake Ferguson 22.3 and James Cook 20.9, and Bryce Young sat on the bench with 24.08 nobody needed. St. Brown Catholic Church was projected for 149.7 and blew past it by 39.32.

Hampton Inn did nothing wrong. Projected for 110.8, it beat that by 49.2 behind Josh Allen's 39.82, the second-best start in the league, plus Denzel Boston at 20.5 and Sam LaPorta at 20.2. It was a 16% underdog going in and played like it wanted the upset. It just drew the one team that was going to be better.

The result: St. Brown Catholic Church is 2-0 with 347.7 points for, 50.8 clear of anyone else, and the sim gives it a 37% title chance, the best in the league.

## The rest of the slate

**Unsolicited Nix pics 130.34, Drake Mungo 125.7.** The closest game of the week and the only upset, with the Nix pics winning at 48% pregame odds. Jaylen Waddle (21.8), Derrick Henry (17.7) and Tyler Warren (17.4) did the steady work, and Parker Washington added 15.8. Drake Mungo got 28.48 from Brock Purdy and 22.1 from Trey McBride, but Kirk Cousins put up 20.22 on the bench while Drake Maye managed 8.02 in the lineup.

**Bijan al-Gaib 149.7, Baby Billys Bible Bonkers 68.84.** Davante Adams went for 39.5, third-best in the league, and Ja'Marr Chase (26.5) and Christian McCaffrey (22.6) piled on. Bijan al-Gaib could afford Malik Nabers' 1.1 and still left Travis Kelce's 29.6 on the bench. Baby Billys Bible Bonkers got 22.6 from Chris Olave and 21.38 from Tyler Shough, then a -0.1 from DJ Moore, who was projected for 13.1.

**Homie G Slicer's Team 123.16, Big Bucky Hunter 65.28.** Homie G Slicer's Team's first win of the year, built on Patrick Mahomes (28.98), DeVonta Smith (27.7) and Kenneth Walker (23.8). Colston Loveland followed up his Week 1 zero with 1.8 against a 14.2 projection, so the tight end spot is still a problem. Big Bucky Hunter got 0.8 from Jaxson Dart, projected for 16.4, and 3.0 from Saquon Barkley, and the 65.28 is the second-lowest score of the season.

**Jeantrification 142.78, These Bitches Love 'Doza 56.32.** The biggest blowout of the week, margin 86.46. Dak Prescott (29.76) and Dalton Kincaid (26.0) led the way, and Jeantrification had enough to leave Tre Tucker's 22.9 and George Kittle's 20.0 on the bench. These Bitches Love 'Doza started a quarterback who scored -0.56 and a receiver who scored 0.0, and the 56.32 is the season low, 8.8 points above the league's all-time worst.

**The Hurt Locker 138.16, Captain Jah'Merica 101.56.** Jaxon Smith-Njigba went for 42.5, the best start of the week, and Jonathan Taylor added 29.2. Captain Jah'Merica got 26.98 from Matthew Stafford and 23.3 from Jahmyr Gibbs, but Justin Herbert (4.88) and Dallas Goedert (1.9) dragged it down. Dalton Schultz scored 32.0 on the bench.

## Start/sit report card

- **Costliest call: Bijan al-Gaib.** Aaron Jones (projected 9.9) took the flex over Travis Kelce (13.0). Jones scored 10.5 and Kelce 29.6, a 19.1-point miss that an 80.86-point win made easy to forgive.
- **The call that cost a game: Drake Mungo.** DK Metcalf and Chuba Hubbard were both projected 12.0, and Metcalf got the flex. He scored 6.7, Hubbard 14.4, and that 7.7 is more than the 4.64 they lost by. The superflex was a bad beat on top of it: Drake Maye (16.9) over Kirk Cousins (11.9) was the right start, and Cousins outscored him 20.22 to 8.02 from the bench.
- **Dead start: These Bitches Love 'Doza.** Cooper Rush went in the superflex on a 0.0 projection and scored -0.56, with Darren Waller (projected 7.5) on the bench for 19.8.
- **Best gut call: Bijan al-Gaib.** Davante Adams (projected 12.1) over Mike Evans (13.6) at receiver, and Adams went for 39.5 to Evans' 8.4. Runner-up: Unsolicited Nix pics played Tyler Warren (13.5) over Tucker Kraft (14.9) at tight end and won it 17.4 to 3.5, more than the 4.64 they won by.
- **Left early, nobody's fault:** Dallas Goedert played 25% of Captain Jah'Merica's snaps, which is how an 11.7 projection turned into 1.9 with Dalton Schultz's 32.0 on the bench. Big Bucky Hunter lost Jaxson Dart (12% of snaps) and Saquon Barkley (16%) the same way.

## Playoff odds movers

| Jeantrification | 80% | 90% | +10 |

Captain Jah'Merica lost a coin-flip game to The Hurt Locker, and that one result swung both teams, sending Captain Jah'Merica below 50/50 and The Hurt Locker above it. The Nix pics' 4.64-point upset over Drake Mungo pushed them to 90%. Big Bucky Hunter's second straight loss, this one by 57.88, leaves it at 2%.

recaps.dek: Unsolicited Nix pics opened 2026 with **166.6** points, the best score of Week 1, and ran a favored Jeantrification out of the building by 49.46. Bo Nix contributed 3.44 of it. Caleb Williams and Derrick Henry contributed 72.56.
recaps.body:
## The headline

Unsolicited Nix pics opened 2026 with **166.6** points, the best score of Week 1, and ran a favored Jeantrification out of the building by 49.46. Bo Nix contributed 3.44 of it. Caleb Williams and Derrick Henry contributed 72.56.

Williams was the top starter in the league at 37.26, and Henry was right behind him at 35.3. David Montgomery added 28.9 out of the flex and Parker Washington chipped in 19.3, which covered for a 1.2 from Jaylen Waddle against a 14.7 projection. Jeantrification came in at 56% to win, and Unsolicited Nix pics' playoff odds jumped from 52% to 73%, the biggest move in the league.

Jeantrification never found a second gear. Ashton Jeanty did his part with 32.7 and Ladd McConkey added 19.2, but Kyle Pitts put up a zero at tight end against a 12.9 projection. The bench was louder than the lineup: Christian Watson matched Jeanty at 32.7, Dalton Kincaid had 20.5 and C.J. Stroud 16.46, all unused. Final: 166.6 to 117.14.

## The rest of the slate

**Hampton Inn 106.62, Big Bucky Hunter 105.24.** The closest game of the week, decided by 1.38, and an upset at 43% pregame. Josh Allen's 34.66 was the third-best start in the league and carried a lineup that got 2.8 from Kenny Gainwell. Big Bucky Hunter had more than enough on the bench to flip it, with Kyle Monangai at 20.4 and Pat Freiermuth at 18.1.

**Captain Jah'Merica 164.76, These Bitches Love 'Doza 77.62.** The blowout of the week, by 87.14. Jahmyr Gibbs (33.6) and D'Andre Swift (32.4) combined for 66.0 out of the backfield, and Dallas Goedert added 25.7 at tight end. These Bitches Love 'Doza posted the week's lowest score, got 0.52 from Sam Darnold against a 16.0 projection, and left Mike Gesicki's 21.3 on the bench.

**St. Brown Catholic Church 158.7, Baby Billys Bible Bonkers 122.5.** The 94% favorite took care of business by 36.2. Amon-Ra St. Brown (28.7), Zay Flowers (26.0) and Javonte Williams (24.2) led the way, while Jalen Coker (33.8) and Bryce Young (31.44) did nothing at all from the bench. Baby Billys Bible Bonkers lost but beat their 97.1 projection by 25.4, with Chris Olave at 28.2 and Trevor Lawrence at 26.1. The sim makes St. Brown Catholic Church the early title favorite at 28%.

**Drake Mungo 144.82, The Hurt Locker 109.14.** Justin Jefferson (31.2) and Trey McBride (29.0) did the heavy lifting in a 35.68-point win, and Brock Purdy's 21.1 in the superflex spot more than doubled Drake Maye's 9.82. Chuba Hubbard's 23.7 sat on the bench. The Hurt Locker got 26.2 from Jaxon Smith-Njigba and 25.1 from Jonathan Taylor, but Kyler Murray finished at -0.38 in the superflex while Jacoby Brissett scored 16.48 on the bench.

**Bijan al-Gaib 134.14, Homie G Slicer's Team 108.46.** Bijan Robinson put up 29.3 for the team that wears his name, and Lamar Jackson added 24.96 in a 25.68-point win. It could have been bigger: Isaiah Likely's 30.8 sat on the bench and Ja'Marr Chase managed 3.2. Kenneth Walker's 34.1 was the fourth-best start of the week, but Homie G Slicer's Team got zeros from both Colston Loveland and Jordan Addison.

## Start/sit report card

- **Costliest call: Bijan al-Gaib.** Brian Thomas (projected 10.5) took the flex over Isaiah Likely (11.6). Thomas scored 6.0 and Likely 30.8 on the bench, a 24.8-point miss that the 25.68-point win covered with almost nothing to spare.
- **Jeantrification's superflex:** Daniel Jones (projected 14.9) over Christian Watson (13.7). Jones scored 9.04, Watson 32.7. Even that 23.7 would not have closed a 49.46-point loss.
- **Best gut call: These Bitches Love 'Doza.** Michael Mayer (projected 4.8) in the flex over Malik Washington (8.4), a 3.6-point gap, and Mayer won it 12.2 to 6.3. About the only thing that went right for them all week.
- **Bad beat: Big Bucky Hunter.** Harold Fannin (projected 13.7) over Pat Freiermuth (8.8) at tight end was the right start. Fannin scored 5.1, Freiermuth 18.1 on the bench, and the game was lost by 1.38.

## Playoff odds movers

How each team's playoff odds moved from before Week 1 kicked off to now.

| Team | Before | Now | Change |

Unsolicited Nix pics got the biggest bump by beating a favored Jeantrification with the week's top score. The Hurt Locker and Homie G Slicer's Team were the big losers, each beaten by more than 25 points with a starter who gave them nothing. Hampton Inn's 1.38-point upset was worth 7 points of playoff odds, a real jump for a team that started the week at 10%.
